description:
World of Warcraft addon updater


## Features
• Linux：the AppImage now carries update information, so tools like AppImageUpdate and Gear Lever can update WowUp

## Changes
• macOS：WowUp is now listed as a utility instead of a game, so it no longer turns on Game Mode while it runs
• Update translations for the newest messages in all languages

## Fixes
• Fix invisible expand/collapse icons in the WTF Explorer tree
• Fix the client selector dropdown being too narrow on My Addons and Get Addons; keep control bar buttons from wrapping
• Fix a false "Failed to get WowUp update" error message that appeared when checking for updates during a temporary network issue
• Fix addon installs sometimes failing with a "not a zip file" error because the download had not finished writing
• Fix links in CurseForge addon changelogs trying to open as a local file instead of in your browser
• Fix the Start Minimized option being ignored
• Windows：Fix WowUp not finding ARM64 World of Warcraft installs in some cases, such as when WowUp runs under emulation
